title: developer-tooling-ops-playbook-and-okr-tracker
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a sustainable operations playbook and living OKR tracker for Developer Experience programs (SDKs, docs, quickstarts, sample apps). Deliverables: ops runbook for onboarding and incidents, per-language SDK readiness checklist (Python/TS/Go), quickstart templates, automated telemetry dashboards, and an OKR dashboard that ties to usage metrics and conversion funnels. Focus is on repeatable rollout patterns (canary -> staged -> GA), measurable gating criteria, and playbook steps for regressions discovered by the eval harness.
comments: 2025-02-14: Kickoff with DX, Eng, Design. Agreed scope: ops playbook + OKR dashboard + 3 quickstarts (python, typescript, go). Action: ENG to provide telemetry hooks by 2025-02-21.
2025-02-20: Design review (DES-221) provided feedback on quickstart UX; recommended single-page example and inline CLI snippets. Marcus to loop in docs writer for copy edits.

2025-02-25: Engineering POC for telemetry completed (PR#3421). Observability team requested additional token-level sampling for cost breakdowns; trade-off: increased ingest vs higher fidelity metrics.
2025-02-28: PM review meeting. Decided to defer non-blocking SDK language features to next cycle; prioritize stable onboarding path and reliability tests. Added canary rollback checklist to playbook.
2025-03-01: Draft playbook uploaded to Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DX/Dev-Tooling-Ops-Playbook. Awaiting security review on secret handling section.
metrics: OKR-1: Increase SDK first-run success rate from 72% -> 90% by 2025-Q2 (measured by quickstart completion funnel)
OKR-2: Reduce median time-to-first-hello (new user) from 14m -> 6m
OKR-3: Reduce dev-reported onboarding incidents by 50% via playbook and automated tests
